'''Qo'el''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and daughter of [[Odar]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
When [[Oradam village]] was searched by Mantellian soldiers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Qo'el was arrested due to her suspected ties with the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatists]]. Taken to [[Fort Garnik]] for interrogation, Qo'el insisted she had no information to share, but her interrogator, [[Kellik]], refused to believe her and began to physically assault to force her to confess what he wanted to hear. Thankfully, a Republic patriot sent by her father [[Odar]] arrived to rescue her.<ref name="TOR" />
